title.narrative: Effective industrial relations to improve working conditions, labour productivity

description.narrative:
Despite the challenging social dialogue at the national level due to the process of adoption of Employment Creation Law since 2020 and its implementing regulations, social partners in selected sector such as palm oil, fishing, garment and recently on energy transition have demonstrated effectiveness of dialogue at the bipartite and tripartite level. Indeed, the constituents recognize the need to move towards collaborative industrial relations through social dialogue, including collective bargaining, and seek mutually acceptable solutions to promote growth, decent work and ensure compliance even as business processes and work environment continue to evolve and change.
In line with the first pillar of Indonesia Decent Work Country Program 2020-2025 -Effective Social Dialogue that Promotes Sustainable Business and Workers' Welfare, ILO has been working with the workers, employers and government to address a number of decent work challenges.
Through technical support, capacity building initiatives and promotion of social dialogue, ILO seeks to enable constituents to find solutions to current and emerging challenges in the world of work and promote decent work. The expected outcomes under this CPO includes: effective industrial relations to improve working conditions and labour productivity, increased labour compliance and implementation of OSH and effective wage policies to promote fair and decent wages through improving minimum wage setting and wage setting practices.
